text:
ravi: FYI console p50 went up slightly after last night's quota-fallback change, but p95/p99 jumped way more. p50 sometimes looks higher than p95 on the endpoint breakdown for /v1/complete? 😕
emily: wait what, p50 > p95 on the chart? can you screenshot?
ravi: screenshot pasted in panel notes. it's not UI flip; the line for p50 is above p95 for a short window (about 2 datapoints). looks like an inversion at 02:12 UTC.
noor: that usually indicates different provenance or aggregator for the two series. are p50 and p95 coming from the same source? (raw vs tdigest vs histogram-interp)
logan: good question. the panel config uses p50 from raw-quantiles when sample_count >= 50, otherwise it falls back to tdigest_merge; p95/p99 are always tdigest_merge on 1m buckets. we recently changed the fallback rules in console.
emily: ahhh so if p50 is switching to raw while p95 is tdigest-merged with sparse samples, inversion can happen. tdigest isn't monotonic when merged across sparse buckets and low-sample histograms can interpolate oddly.
ravi: timeline: routing policy changed (quota fallback enabled) at 02:10Z, then quota-engine started rerouting small payloads to a low-latency pool that we sample less aggressively. deploy-bot: quota-fallback-rollout deployed 2025-03-08T02:10Z by ci/cd. ✅
noor: hypothesis: quota fallback reduced samples in the tdigest buckets for that endpoint, causing p95 to be computed from sparse merged tdigest (or histogram interp) while p50 used stable raw samples -> inversion artifact.
logan: can we check sample_count per-minute for that window? if sample_count dips, tdigest_merge artifacts are likely.
emily: sample_count for the two minutes: 1) 42 samples, 2) 31 samples. p50_series at that time used raw because our threshold is >=30, weird edge-case when threshold flips between buckets.
ravi: so we have a race: p50 picks raw for bucket A (>=30) but p95 uses tdigest_merge(1m) that was built from adjacent merged buckets with <30 effective samples -> mismatch.
noor: reproduction plan: replay traffic with sampling toggles to show inversion when threshold boundary crossed. I can run that locally.
logan: short-term UX mitigation: make provenance explicit on legend lines: e.g., "p50 (raw)" vs "p95 (tdigest_merge 1m)" and a hover that shows sample_count and rollup_window. users currently assume same source.
emily: +1. also adjust threshold logic: use same provenance logic for all percentiles in a panel to prevent mixed-sources per point. either prefer raw if any percentile has enough samples or fallback to merged for all.
ravi: ops impact: oncall got alerted due to p99 SLO rule. we should annotate the alert with recent deploys and rollup changes. also add an immediate dashboard annotation: quota-fallback-rollout at 02:10Z.
logan: infra note: we've been moving to 1m rollup windows to save cost; that makes tdigest_merge more sensitive to burst alignment. might want to keep shorter windows for high-cardinality endpoints or increase sampling there.
noor: replay done: when sampling drops to ~1/8 and 1m merge used, p95_ui jumps and p50_raw stays low, inversion reproduces. snippet:
```
# replay snippet
sampling=1/1 merge=15s p50=220ms p95=430ms
sampling=1/8 merge=60s p50=220ms p95=880ms  # inversion observed because p50 uses raw overlay
```
emily: that confirms it. next steps: (1) immediate dashboard annotation + alert annotation (ravi/emily); (2) console change to show provenance on legend/hover and to prefer consistent provenance across percentiles in the same panel (logan + UX); (3) infra: consider pinning rollup window to 15s for endpoints tagged "latency-sensitive" or raise sampling for them (noor + infra); (4) add CI replay test that fails when p50 > p95 for same endpoint unless sample_count<10.
ravi: I'll add the dashboard annotation and update the oncall alert text. filing tickets for the console provenance and panel-consistency change.
logan: I'll draft the console patch to label series and unify provenance selection per-panel. want to avoid changing default too much before we discuss with UX.
noor: I'll open an infra ticket to mark endpoints as latency-sensitive and add a small experiment to keep their rollup window at 15s. also will add a backstop: when sample_count drops below threshold for tdigest, the console should show a subtle caution icon on percentile lines.
emily: good. small docs note: add SLO FAQ entry explaining "why p50 can appear higher than p95" and link to provenance doc. saves oncall churn.
ravi: thanks all. I'll close once annotation + alert text updated and tickets filed. leaving thread open for PR links. :thumbsup:
